How to use Bobine

For creators who post every day, marketing teams that need many consistent videos, small businesses without an editor, and journalists who edit on a phone.

Open Bobine ↗Platform detailsContact

Guided tourReal screens

Plays automatically. Use the dots or arrows to move, Pause to stop.

01

Getting started

1

Go to bobine-tau.vercel.app. The interface is in French; switch to English with EN at the top.

2

Try the editor without an account, or sign up to receive 100 free credits.

3

Create a project: choose a format, add your footage and, if you want, your own music.

4

Request the first cut (20 credits). The agent plans, edits, reviews and fixes it.

5

Adjust it by typing instructions, then export in 9:16 and 16:9.

02

Features

01

Studio

Projects, formats, agents and your music, with links to Cinéma, the guide and the book.

STEPS

  1. Create a project from the sidebar
  2. Choose one of the 15 formats
  3. Add footage; it stays on your device
02

Editor

The first cut comes with captions, titles, color grading and music lowered under speech. You request changes in plain words.

STEPS

  1. Watch the first cut
  2. Type the changes you want
  3. Switch between 9:16 and 16:9
  4. Export in HD, or 4K on Pro
03

Cinéma

Generates AI scenes: describe the shot, choose the look, camera, movement, light and color, then render one to four takes.

STEPS

  1. Describe the scene or start from a preset
  2. Choose the model, format and duration
  3. Download the take or edit it in Bobine
04

Guide and book

A 50-page illustrated guide to every screen, in French and English, and the book Bobine, la méthode, on filming for the edit.

STEPS

  1. Open the guide from the sidebar
  2. Search a term or read in order
  3. Buy the book by card or with a code
05

Plans and credits

Découverte is free with 100 credits. Créateur, Pro and Studio add credits, remove the watermark and unlock Cinéma and 4K. Local editing is free and unlimited.

STEPS

  1. Open the credits page
  2. Choose a plan or a credit pack
  3. Pay by card, or in cash or Mobile Money through the contact page
03Tips
  • Film a wide shot, a detail and a face for each scene; the edit needs all three.
  • Add your music: cuts follow its beats.
  • Export both ratios every time.
04FAQ
Is my footage uploaded?

No. Editing and export run in your browser. Only short text descriptions go to the AI.

How much does a cut cost?

20 credits for a first cut. One credit is about one US cent.

Can I pay in cash?

Yes. Pay through the contact page and you receive a code.

Which languages?

French and English.
